mapper.sql: JOIN feature_snapshot fs ON fs.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id JOIN ( SELECT feature_snapshot_id, MAX(predicted_at) AS max_predicted_at FROM prediction_result WHERE model_version = #{modelVersion} GROUP BY feature_snapshot_id ) latest ON latest.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id AND latest.max_predicted_at = pr.predicted_at
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.prediction_id) AS predictionCompletedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.risk_grade = 'WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highRiskCustomerCount, SUM(CASE WHEN previous_pr.hazard_3m IS NOT NULL AND pr.hazard_3m > previous_pr.hazard_3m THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS riskIncreasedCustomerCount FROM prediction_result pr
LEFT JOIN feature_snapshot previous_fs ON previous_fs.customer_id = fs.customer_id AND previous_fs.base_ym = #{previousBaseYm} AND previous_fs.feature_schema_version = fs.feature_schema_version LEFT JOIN prediction_result previous_pr ON previous_pr.feature_snapshot_id = previous_fs.feature_snapshot_id AND previous_pr.model_version = #{modelVersion} WHERE fs.base_ym = #{baseYm} AND pr.model_version = #{modelVersion}

SELECT pr.risk_grade AS riskGrade, CASE pr.risk_grade WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상' WHEN 'INTEREST' THEN '관심' WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN '주의' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN '경고' END AS riskGradeName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM prediction_result pr
WHERE fs.base_ym = #{baseYm} AND pr.model_version = #{modelVersion} GROUP BY pr.risk_grade ORDER BY FIELD(pr.risk_grade, 'NORMAL', 'INTEREST', 'CAUTION', 'WARNING')

SELECT fs.customer_id AS customerId, pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, pr.risk_grade AS riskGrade, CASE pr.risk_grade WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상' WHEN 'INTEREST' THEN '관심' WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN '주의' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN '경고' END AS riskGradeName, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.hazard_3m - previous_pr.hazard_3m AS riskChange3m, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pr.reasons, '$[0].displayName')), '주요 요인 없음') AS primaryRiskFactor FROM prediction_result pr
LEFT JOIN feature_snapshot previous_fs ON previous_fs.customer_id = fs.customer_id AND previous_fs.base_ym = #{previousBaseYm} AND previous_fs.feature_schema_version = fs.feature_schema_version LEFT JOIN prediction_result previous_pr ON previous_pr.feature_snapshot_id = previous_fs.feature_snapshot_id AND previous_pr.model_version = #{modelVersion} WHERE fs.base_ym = #{baseYm} AND pr.model_version = #{modelVersion} AND pr.risk_grade = 'WARNING' ORDER BY pr.hazard_3m DESC LIMIT #{limit}
